Type 1 Narrative and Plans 6521 S Rhodes

1. A (narrative) Existing RT-4 zoned two improved lots, measuring combined 48’x122.25’
with an existing 2 story, 2DU building on one of the lots. The applicant seeks a rezoning
to allow for the sub-division of the existing improved zoned lots into two lots measuring
24’x122.25’ each. Resulting in one 24’x122.25’ lot with an existing 2 story, 2DU building
to remain at 6521 S Rhodes with zoning relief to reduce the side setbacks through 17-
13-1001-B and a vacant zoned lot measuring 24’x122.25’ lot at 6519 S Rhodes.

2. -Reducing North setback requirement from 2’-0” to existing 0.74 ft
-Reducing combined setback requirement from 4.8 ft to existing 3.37ft
